card.name: Opening parenthesis before abbreviations
card.fires_on: An opening parenthesis right after a long spelled-out term (e.g. maximum recommended human dose, multidrug resistance protein), where an abbreviation such as MRHD, P-gp or MRP comes next. Also some digits inside dose figures.

modes.label: Parenthesis before acronym
modes.description: The bracket that introduces an abbreviation after a full term.
modes.example: approximately 5 times (rabbits) the maximum recommended human dose<< (>>MRHD) in adults.

modes.label: Digit in dose strengths
modes.description: A number inside a mg strength list, such as the 0 in 250 or the 2 in 2-mg.
modes.example: (lumacaftor 400 mg/ivacaftor 25<<0>> mg per dose) 2 tablets of

card.writes: It promotes capital-letter abbreviation pieces like LM, IM, WM and suppresses words starting with M such as Match and Mix.
card.plain: It fires at the bracket that opens an abbreviation after a long drug-label term, and at some digits in dose strengths.
